purpose: Stage 1B dataset lineage manifest - independent-family status of the five candidate expansion datasets, verified against actual repository history and actual dataset source pages/files, not the prior web-audit's classification alone.

GalaxyPPG.official_name: GalaxyPPG: A PPG Signal Dataset Collected in Semi-Naturalistic Settings Using Galaxy Watch
GalaxyPPG.version: as published, Scientific Data 2025 / Zenodo record 14635823
GalaxyPPG.underlying_source_family: Novel data collection (Galaxy Watch 5 + Empatica E4 + Polar H10), not derived from any existing public dataset.
GalaxyPPG.verified_by_grep: No reference to 'GalaxyPPG', 'Galaxy Watch', or zenodo.org/records/14635823 anywhere in the repository prior to this sprint.
GalaxyPPG.reasoning: Distinct subjects, distinct devices (Galaxy Watch5/E4/Polar H10), distinct protocol from this project's existing PPG-DaLiA (wrist E4 + RespiBAN) work. Same scientific QUESTION (does synchronized wrist IMU add HR information beyond PPG-only), different dataset family -> genuine independent replication, Type 1.

HMC.official_name: Haaglanden Medisch Centrum sleep staging database
HMC.underlying_source_family: Clinical PSG referrals at Haaglanden Medisch Centrum (Netherlands), 2018 - unrelated to Sleep-EDF (which is Physionet's separate, older, healthy-subject Sleep Cassette/Telemetry collection at a different institution).
HMC.verified_by_grep: No reference to 'HMC', 'Haaglanden', or 'hmc-sleep-staging' anywhere in the repository prior to this sprint. This project's only existing Sleep dataset is Sleep-EDF (datasets/sleep-edfx/, ml/datasets/sleep_edf.py).
HMC.reasoning: Different institution, different subject population (clinical sleep-disorder referrals vs Sleep-EDF's healthy/mild-disorder cohort), different EEG montage (F4/C4/O2/C3 vs Sleep-EDF's Fpz-Cz/Pz-Oz), different recording hardware/era. Same scientific QUESTION (EEG vs EEG+EOG) -> genuine independent replication, Type 1.

QDE_V2.version: v1.0.0 (same file already in repo - this is a NEW EXPERIMENT on the EXISTING file, not a new dataset version)
QDE_V2.underlying_source_family: Same PhysioNet QDE treadmill-dehydration protocol already used by ml/train_bioimpedance.py.
QDE_V2.existing_result: No archived results/*.json was found for the historical run; ml/train_bioimpedance.py and datasets/qde-bioimpedance/README.md document the historical experiment (LOSO MLP, target=TBW liters, features=5 impedance + 11 temperature). Reconstructed from source, not from a missing results file.
QDE_V2.reasoning: 'QDE V2' is explicitly NOT a new dataset - the prior research audit's naming is a project-internal label for a NEW sensor-value experiment (bilateral leg impedance vs arm+trunk) on data this project has held since an earlier sprint. Correctly classified as Type 3 (new experiment, existing family), not counted toward 'five new independent datasets'.

LBNP.official_name: Non-invasive biomarkers for detecting progression toward hypovolemic cardiovascular instability in a lower body negative pressure model (dataset)
LBNP.underlying_source_family: Novel LBNP chamber study (invasive arterial line MAP + ECG/pleth + EIT/EIS), unrelated to any dataset already in this repository.
LBNP.verified_by_grep: No reference to 'LBNP', 'lower body negative pressure', or 'zenodo.org/records/10119427' anywhere in the repository prior to this sprint.
LBNP.reasoning: New physiological challenge paradigm (exogenously controlled hypovolemia), new modality (thoracic bio-impedance spectroscopy) at high acquisition complexity, new subject cohort. Type 3 (new sensor-value experiment) AND new independent family simultaneously.

ds003838.official_name: EEG, pupillometry, ECG and photoplethysmography, and behavioral data in the digit span task and rest
ds003838.underlying_source_family: Ural Federal University digit-span working-memory study - unrelated to any existing project dataset.
ds003838.verified_by_grep: No reference to 'ds003838', 'digit span', or 'working memory' EEG data anywhere in the repository prior to this sprint. This project's only prior cognitive-EEG candidates (STEW, per ml/datasets/stew.py) are unrelated.
ds003838.reasoning: New target domain entirely (externally-imposed memory load, not cardiovascular/sleep), new subject cohort, new EEG montage (63-channel actiCHamp, 1000 Hz). Type 2 (new target/domain).
